text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Spring). Ah, what a 
magnificent ring it has! Today's victory 
shall surely elevate the King's prestige.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
I will become the undisputed King of 
Kings. Now, onward to the traditional 
stage!
